title: Settings
confirmReset: Are you sure you want to reset all settings?
autoLaunchDesc: Automatically run the app when system starts
rerankEnabledDesc: Run reranking after hybrid retrieval before final chunk selection

rerankHeuristicFallbackDesc: Use lexical heuristic rerank when provider rerank is unavailable or fails
ragTopKDesc: Number of retrieved chunks passed to answer generation
ragThresholdDesc: Minimum relevance score for vector retrieval candidates
ragShortQueryLengthDesc: Queries shorter than this can be treated as chit-chat
ragChitChatHeuristicDesc: Skip RAG on short and greeting-like messages

ragDocTopKDesc: How many documents the selection stage keeps before chunk retrieval
checkUpdateError: Update check failed, click to retry
baseUrlHint: Base URL for the API service
